_comment: Setting presets (the setup wizard starts with 'Choose a preset'; individual settings are under 'Customize'). settings override the program's defaults (scenario-defaults.json, then programs.json); a preset may also set speed and hint which cases Generate prefers (cases: patient tags, mix: triage counts per student). Programs list which presets they offer. All drafts for the instructor (SPEC §14).

presets.label: Standard med-surg
presets.description: The usual defaults: manikin task timers, delegation with queueing, recovery penalties, graded reassessments.

presets.label: Beginner – gentle timing
presets.description: Late and very-late limits doubled, no recovery penalties, the handoff report every time, reassessments not graded. For a first sim.

presets.label: Code-heavy
presets.description: Sicker patients (Generate prefers red cardiac and sepsis cases) and recovery penalties on. Codes still come from each case's own script or Add event.

presets.label: Delegation focus
presets.description: Full task times on screen (so delegating matters), an extra CNA per group, queueing allowed; delegation overload is flagged.

presets.label: Manikin lab
presets.description: Tasks happen on the manikin: short screen lockouts, and temperature, RR and pain come from the manikin or you (the Measure button doesn't reveal them).

presets.label: Screen-only
presets.description: No manikins: tasks take their full time on screen and the Measure button reveals every vital.
